question.local_fq_resistance.label: Local E. coli fluoroquinolone resistance

exclude.urinary_agent_systemic: Excluded: tissue levels too low for a systemic urinary infection
exclude.tmp_smx_resistance: Excluded: local E. coli TMP-SMX resistance is 20% or more
exclude.recent_fq: Excluded: fluoroquinolone used in the last 6 months
warn.recent_fq: Warning: fluoroquinolone used in the last 12 months; resistance is more likely
uti.idsa.pregnancy: The IDSA guidelines do not cover pregnancy; specialist review is needed.
uti.idsa.sepsis: Urinary infection with sepsis: broad parenteral treatment and urgent assessment.
uti.idsa.cystitis_male: IDSA guidance on cystitis in men is not yet published; seek specialist advice.
uti.idsa.cystitis: Uncomplicated cystitis: nitrofurantoin, TMP-SMX, fosfomycin or pivmecillinam; fluoroquinolones and beta-lactams come later.
uti.idsa.out_lt10: Outpatient pyelonephritis with fluoroquinolone resistance below 10%: an oral fluoroquinolone.
uti.idsa.out_ge10: Fluoroquinolone resistance of 10% or more: one dose of a long-acting parenteral agent before oral treatment.
uti.idsa.inpatient: Inpatient: a parenteral beta-lactam or fluoroquinolone; carbapenems and aminoglycosides come later. 7 days.
uti.idsa.male_systemic: In men possible prostate involvement may lengthen the course.
uti.idsa.esbl: Previous ESBL producer: consider a carbapenem or choose by susceptibility.
uti.note.obstruction: With obstruction or an anomaly, urological assessment and source control are needed.
uti.eau.sepsis: Urosepsis: the EAU section is under revision; urgent management per sepsis guidance.
uti.eau.cystitis_pregnant: Cystitis in pregnancy: fosfomycin, cefadroxil, pivmecillinam or nitrofurantoin (not near term).
uti.eau.pregnant_systemic: Pyelonephritis in pregnancy: a parenteral cephalosporin; 7-10 days in total.
uti.eau.cystitis: Cystitis: fosfomycin, nitrofurantoin or pivmecillinam; TMP-SMX only when local resistance is below 20%.
uti.eau.cystitis_male: Cystitis in men: TMP-SMX for 7 days; pivmecillinam or nitrofurantoin when prostate involvement is excluded.
uti.eau.out_lt10: Outpatient pyelonephritis with fluoroquinolone resistance below 10%: a short oral fluoroquinolone.
uti.eau.out_ge10: Fluoroquinolone resistance of 10% or more: one parenteral dose, then an oral cephalosporin or TMP-SMX.
uti.eau.inpatient: Inpatient: a parenteral fluoroquinolone or cephalosporin; broader options by severity.
uti.eau.inpatient_resistant: Fluoroquinolone resistance of 10% or more: parenteral options without a fluoroquinolone.
uti.eau.esbl: Previous ESBL producer: switch to a carbapenem.
uti.eau.male_systemic: Systemic infection in men: 14 days when prostate involvement cannot be excluded.
syndrome.uti.aliases: cystitis, pyelonephritis, dysuria, urinary, kidney infection, UTI
